data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Raimundus', meaning 'wise counsel', 'protector' or 'recommender'. The name Raymonde has strong associations with the Christian saints of the same name, including Saint Raymond of Penyafort and Saint Raymonde of Capua. It carries the spiritual connotations of wisdom, guidance, and protection.

data.etymology: Raymonde belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Adviser, wise protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raymonde total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
